newsitem.title: UK: BOXER NIGEL BENN CHARGED WITH GRIEVOUS BODILY HARM.
newsitem.headline: BOXER NIGEL BENN CHARGED WITH GRIEVOUS BODILY HARM.

text.p: British boxer Nigel Benn was charged with grievous bodily harm on Thursday after an incident at a London nightclub in September, police said.
The 32-year-old super-middleweight boxer, who announced his retirement from the ring last week, is to spend the night in police custody before appearing before magistrates on Friday, police added.
Benn, who retired after being beaten by Irishman Steve Collins in a WBO title challenge, ended his boxing career with a record of 48 fights, 42 wins, one draw and five defeats.
